tools.description: Update user permissions for an advertising account. Pass accessRequestedAccount in the body to specify the account. First call user_permissions-list_user_permissions to get the current permission object structure, then pass { body: { accessRequestedAccount: { advertiserAccountId: "<id>" }, userPermissions: [...] } } with the updated objects.

accessRequestedAccount.description: The advertiser account to perform the operation on.

userPermissions.description: List of user permissions to update.

tools.name: update_user_permissions

tools.description: Query roles for a specific user on an advertising account (e.g. { body: { accessRequestedAccount: { advertiserAccountId: "<id>" }, userId: "<id>" } }). Requires userId from users-list_users. Pass accessRequestedAccount in the body to specify the account. Returns role names and country scopes.

accessRequestedAccount.description: The advertiser account to perform the operation on.

userId.description: User ID to query roles for. Obtain from users-list_users.

tools.name: list_user_roles

tools.description: List users with access to an advertising account. Pass accessRequestedAccount in the body to specify the account. Returns userId and masked email for each user. Include maxResults/nextToken in body for pagination.

accessRequestedAccount.description: The advertiser account to perform the operation on.

tools.name: list_users
